A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Rex solver work. All 73 pages of each version, including Appendices A–H, support comparison through text extraction and visual inspection; no material gaps were found.

before.justification: v4 reports original reconstruction, image generation/editing, Boltzmann sampling, profiling, and ablation results in Section 4 and Appendix H.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical studies, including quantitative results in Tables 1 and 4–9 and qualitative generation and interpolation examples.

M1.justification: The Princeps and Rex constructions, forward/backward updates, solver components, and Brownian reconstruction procedure are unchanged. The revised mathematical assumptions do not introduce a different algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions retain CelebA-HQ generation, COCO text-to-image generation, pix2pix reconstruction/editing, FRLL interpolation, and tri-alanine sampling. No distinct dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments, including DDIM, EDICT, BDIA, O-BELM, and the Boltzmann baselines. EDICT's failure and omission from the editing table are already reported in v4.

E3.justification: Appendix G.3 changes the stated fixed-step editing budget from 100 inversion plus 100 generation steps to 50 plus 50. This resolves disagreement with Figure 9's caption, which specifies 50 plus 50 in both versions. The PDFs establish a reported setting correction, not that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The finite-precision reconstruction study, component ablations, Brownian Interval profiling, latent-space failure analyses, and interpolation study are unchanged. The replaced gallery image does not introduce a new analytical question or robustness test.

E5.justification: Fixed-seed matching and mean/point-estimate reporting remain unchanged. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or a different uncertainty-estimation procedure.

E6.justification: All numerical tables are unchanged, but reported comparisons change. Section 4.3 corrects the LPIPS reduction from roughly 2× against the strongest reversible baseline to 1.31× against O-BELM and 2× against DDIM, consistent with Table 7. Appendix H.3 changes the claimed CLIP gap from 0.1 to 0.23 points, although Table 6 still shows a 0.36-point gap at 50 steps (Rex(Midpoint) 31.60 versus DDIM 31.24). Figure 17 also replaces one generated sample.

T1.justification: Proposition 3.1 replaces g²=ab and b/a tending to infinity with g²=bΞ, retaining b>0. Appendix C.2.1 correspondingly replaces divergence reasoning with strict monotonicity of the time change. Appendix D corrects C/σ_T to C/α_T in the noise-prediction proof and repairs the squared-error scaling factors in Equations 209, 211, and 214. The convergence conclusions are retained.

C1.justification: The introductory Figure 1 caption withdraws the claim that zero reconstruction error holds regardless of arithmetic precision, qualifying the central exact-reversibility claim. The abstract and contribution list retain the same solver family, convergence, inversion, and application contributions.

C2.justification: Section 4.4 explicitly distinguishes algebraic inversion in exact arithmetic from floating-point error amplification through ζ⁻¹ when ζ is small. Section 4.3 removes the characterization of LPIPS as the most direct measure of edit faithfulness and instead describes its comparison of edited and original images.

D1.justification: Appendix G.3 revises the documented editing step budget from 100+100 to 50+50, improving consistency of the reproduction instructions. Other implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware information, and code/data access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive comparisons with prior reversible and diffusion solvers are unchanged in Section 5 and Appendices A and E. No new research positioning or novelty relationship is introduced.

P1.justification: Localized rewriting affects the mathematical statements, editing and Boltzmann discussions, conclusion, and several appendix passages. Section order, terminology, and the overall narrative and appendix structure remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption is revised, and Figure 17 replaces its second-row, third-column dining image with a skateboarder image. There is limited text/equation reflow; the remaining figures and table structures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 improves mathematical and reporting consistency through the Proposition 3.1 and convergence-proof corrections, reconciliation of the editing step budget, accurate LPIPS ratios, and clearer finite-precision limitations. These are useful, localized repairs to an otherwise unchanged study. The revised CLIP summary in Appendix H.3 remains inconsistent with Table 6, so the reporting cleanup is incomplete.
